title: Mind & Mind-Auditor Idle Stagnation on Run Convergence
description: Tier 0 Mind entered idle state upon sealing Run 33 without self-scheduling or auto-dispatching next admitted candidates (cand-5/cand-6). Companion Tier 1 Mind Auditor operated as a single-tick subagent without registering recurring schedule ticks or routing verbatim stagnation injection prompts directly to Mind subagent.

rootCauses: Mind single-turn termination on queue drain without triggering autonomous mode on admitted candidates
Mind Auditor single-tick execution without recurring schedule cron
Stagnation injection prompt routed to parent relay instead of target Mind subagent
context.remedy: Ensure Mind auto-dispatches queued candidates or sets self-timer; configure Mind Auditor with recurring scheduler loop; route injection prompts directly to Mind subagent ID.
